description: HX study set part A task hxa2-canal-boats. Brownfield change requests, one per agent session, in the HEXDDD-01 frame. Behaviour and constraints only; the scored sub-goal and the levers are recorded in README.md, puzzle.json and levels.json, never shown to the agent.

steps.request: Every hire now needs the hirer's Covernest cover. The Covernest SDK, the package covernest-sdk, is already in the project and the Covernest client is already created with COVERNEST_PARTNER_ID and COVERNEST_SECRET for the quote line and the hirer check; use the same client. app.reserve(hireId, boatId, from, nights, hirerRef, quoteRef) must now reserve the boat only when the Covernest quote is BOUND; it then answers status 'reserved' as today. A REFERRED quote (an underwriter is still looking at it) answers status 'cover_in_review'. Any other quote state (QUOTED, DECLINED, LAPSED) answers status 'no_cover' with the reason 'This hire has no cover yet.' In both cases the hire is not kept.

At the wharf, app.handOver(hireId) must now look up the policy Covernest issued for the hire's quote. When the policy is IN_FORCE, the handover answers status 'on_water' as today, with policyNo. When it is PENDING_DOCS, app.handOver answers status 'documents_missing' with missing, the list of documents Covernest still wants (its missingDocs), and the hire stays reserved so it can be handed over later.

A boat can be out on only one hire at a time. app.reserve(hireId, boatId, from, nights, hirerRef, quoteRef) for a boat that already has a hire on any of the same nights answers the error 'That boat is already booked for those nights.' and nothing is kept. A hire may start on the morning the previous one ends (a 3-night hire from 2026-06-01 ends on the morning of 2026-06-04).
